## prompt-3-full-paper

*Generated by Process A from [`../prompts/prompt-paper.md`](../prompts/prompt-paper.md),
adapting `trial-protocol/sub-prompts/prompt-3-full-protocol.md` to the paper build
(paper v1.0, repository v4.2.0). Runs in stage `trial-documents/full-paper/`.*

Author the **Stage 3 full paper** of *Phase 1 Pancreatic Cancer Trial Efficient
LLM Document Generations* into `trial-documents/full-paper/`.

**Goal.** Execute every draft `[DRAFTING INSTRUCTION]`: write full prose for each
section, render each referenced Mermaid figure as a TikZ `mermaidfig`, and fill
every table. The full paper must read as a complete, comprehensive scientific
paper, not a scaffold.

**Files (Rule 6, one commit each).** `main.tex`, `paperstyle.sty`,
`references.bib`, `README.md`, then one commit per section `.tex` (the same eight
section files as the draft).

**Figures.** Reproduce the Stage 1 Mermaid figures as TikZ using the `mm*` node
styles in `paperstyle.sty` (recolored to the five-step palette #8B2E3F, #2F5D7C,
#D08770, #BFD7EA, #F4F7F9 plus grayscale). Each LaTeX figure must carry the same
complexity and completeness as its Python Mermaid source. Verify twice that every
figure (a) has no text-box and arrow overlaps, (b) has curved arrows with the
correct specified looseness, and (c) has proper spacing between boxes. Optimize
column widths for aesthetics based on the
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/publication` methods and the amount of text per
column.

**Tables.** Every table is the width of the body text and uses
`>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{...}` (the `L{}` / `Y` column types) so every
cell is left-aligned with no large interword gaps. Tables carry real quantitative
data from the author sources and the four research sources.

**Content coverage.** Address the six ACCELERATION targets; the three OUTLINE
themes; the document-type decision-gate taxonomy (hard / protocol-defined /
decision gates); the before/during/after Phase 1 data-collection and document
workflow; the 1-4 day iteration cadence; figure grounding and the five
name-matching verifications; probable benefit greater than probable risk; and the
prior single-prompt multi-file developments (Phase 2 `trial-phase-2`; the
`law-physical-ai-trials` review/adoption/enactment directories; the
`single-prompt-bill` auto-bill-01 and auto-bill-02 directories; and the 2025 trial
application papers) as evidence leading up to this project.

**Commit schedule (Rules 6, 7, 8).** One commit per file in real time (10+
commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all figure overlaps, table widths, and
reference errors. The last commit writes `sections/README.md`,
`output-full-paper.md`, and `full-paper-LaTeX.zip`. Do not stall, ask questions, or
go into plan mode.
